goal: Dead code review: unused functions, unreachable branches and commented-out blocks.
use: Dead code review: unused functions, unreachable branches and commented-out blocks. Use when a change removes or leaves behind code.

steps.note: Find unused. List functions, types and imports with no caller.
Find unreachable. Flag branches that cannot run given the checks before them.
Find commented-out blocks left in the code.
Confirm before removal. Check for reflection, plugins or external callers.
Report. Each item with file and line, and whether it is safe to remove.
